title: fix: p-video aspect ratio and Recraft vector 3:2 rejection
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Fixed p-video text-to-video ignoring `aspectRatio`: a requested 9:16 ratio is now sent to the provider instead of producing a square video. Fixed Recraft vector rejecting 3:2-shaped reference images or requested sizes by sharing Recraft Flash’s ratio resolver and supported list: 1:1, 4:3, 3:4, 16:9, 9:16, and auto. Gen no longer rejects explicit `aspectRatio` values using its own provider lists for p-video or either Recraft model; it passes them through so provider errors can report accepted values. The lists remain in use for snapping width and height. Added ratio regression tests and removed tests for Gen’s former rejection behavior.
